Enter into the input all or part of the selected taret name while in a talk dialog.
For example: "Moyce" in the Crystarium.

Alternatively, wrap your text in forward slashes to use as a regex.
As such: "/(Moyce|Eirikur)/"

Double click an entry for quick enable/disable.
Ctrl-Shift right click a line to delete it and any children.
